evidence.reason: `_existing` treats a capped `gh issue list --limit 20` result set as exhaustive and returns None when no exact title appears among the first 20 rows. Since `file_issue` then creates a new issue, an existing exact-title issue outside that window can be duplicated, contradicting the module's stated idempotent-by-exact-title behavior. The finding is an ordinary correctness defect in existing intended behavior, not a request for new scope.
